title: Reject invalid sample ages before clearing synthetic crossmatches
prompt:
Fix age validation only in lib/ohworks-bloodbank-crossmatch-hold.ts. Evidence: evaluateCrossmatchHold checks sampleAgeHours > maxSampleAgeHoursForType at line 73 without validating either operand. The fallback at lines 99-103 then claims the sample is within the policy age limit. I reproduced a negative screen, empty antibody history, two requested units, sampleAgeHours=NaN and maxSampleAgeHoursForType=72 returning clear_to_crossmatch. A missing numeric age cannot establish that conclusion. The demo evaluates these inputs and exposes the decision at lib/ohworks-demo-crossmatch-culture-view.ts:95-97.

Before disposition selection, require sampleAgeHours to be a finite non-negative number and maxSampleAgeHoursForType to be a finite positive number. Throw deterministic field-specific validation errors for invalid values, without echoing the submitted values. Preserve the existing strict greater-than expiry boundary and precedence among expired samples, pending screens and antibody workup. This is a synthetic evaluator fix, not a change to clinical policy. Leave other input domains outside this job.

Add tests/ohworks/crossmatch-age-validation.test.ts covering NaN, infinities, negative sample ages, zero/negative limits, and valid zero-age and exact-limit controls. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/crossmatch-age-validation.test.ts tests/ohworks/bloodbank-crossmatch-hold.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-crossmatch-culture-view.test.ts. Existing evaluator tests passed and the NaN defect was reproduced with assertions. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json or auth changes. Keep this one production-file change and work on the assigned branch you are on.
